mapper.select: SELECT id, tool_name AS toolName, enabled, params, status, version_no AS versionNo, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM tool_config WHERE tool_name = #{toolName}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tool_config (tool_name, enabled, params, status, version_no) VALUES (#{toolName}, #{enabled}, #{params}, #{status}, #{versionNo}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE enabled = VALUES (enabled), params = VALUES (params)
